conf.description: Lookup Manager: shape Splunk inputlookup export rows into staging events for the Lake dataset lookup_staging

conf.comment: Input: Splunk /services/search/v2/jobs/export (output_mode=json), one line per row: {"preview":false,"result":{...}}. The collector adds splunk_lookup (the lookup name) and, for runs started by the Lookup Manager App, sync_id (one per request). Output: one JSON event per row, sourcetype cribl:lookup:staging, sent to the cloud HEC source and routed to Lake dataset lookup_staging.

functions.description: Drop preview, progress and message lines
One clean JSON row per event

add.name: _raw
add.value: JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, result, { splunk_lookup: splunk_lookup || 'unknown_lookup', sync_id: sync_id || undefined }))

functions.description: Send only the row and its metadata
